svg.title: Different ways to use the same dependency graph
svg.desc: For a triangle and six isolated vertices, with all coordinate oscillations one, the Janson denominator is 27. Zhang's Example 2.7 gives the feasible value 81/4, or 20.25. Another feasible forest cover gives (sqrt(11)+1)^2, about 18.63. Using independence between connected components gives 15. Smaller valid denominators yield tighter exponential tail bounds; no optimum is asserted.
